text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp arrives for 
K.S.Miracle. The Trainer, still unable to 
shake their anxiety, subtly encourages her 
to take a break and refresh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle was delighted to share a room 
with Yamanin Zephyr, and Yamanin Zephyr 
replied that she had also wanted to talk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, a summer that would decide 
K.S.Miracle's future was about to begin.
